scripts.build: npm run check:site && npm run build:local && npm --prefix app run db:init
scripts.build:ui: npm --prefix chest-ui ci --include=dev && npm --prefix chest-ui run build
scripts.build:local: npm run build:ui && node unpack.cjs && npm --prefix app ci --omit=dev
scripts.test: npm --prefix tests test && npm run test:site
scripts.test:server: node tests/transaction-review.cjs && node tests/financial-server.cjs && node tests/gameplay-options-server.cjs
